shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Only when independent containment is justified.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Documentation preview of the existing solid action treatment; not a runtime component.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:44px; padding:8px 18px; border:0; border-radius:var(--bt-r-control,14px); background:var(--bt-action,#087454); color:#fff; font:600 14px/1.5 "Nunito Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--bt-action-deep,#065F46); } .ds-primary:active { opacity:.85; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bt-accent-text,#087454); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Neutral field; the visible label is not a placeholder.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--bt-text-2,#7C746E); font:400 14px/1.5 "Nunito Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-field input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:10px 14px; border:1px solid var(--bt-border,#E9E3DB); border-radius:var(--bt-r-control,14px); background:var(--bt-surface,#FFFDFB); color:var(--bt-text-1,#1F1A17); font:inherit; font-size:16px; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:var(--bt-text-2,#7C746E); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bt-accent-text,#087454); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Contained surface
components.description: Existing surface vocabulary, not a default wrapper for every section.
components.html:
Recorded sessions

One independent group of records.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:20px; border-radius:var(--bt-r-card,22px); background:var(--bt-surface,#FFFDFB); color:var(--bt-text-1,#1F1A17); box-shadow:var(--bt-elev-1,0 1px 2px rgba(38,32,26,.04)); font:400 14px/1.5 "Nunito Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0; font-size:18px; } .ds-card p { margin:8px 0 0; color:var(--bt-text-2,#7C746E); }

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Familiar neutral navigation with a meaningful active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:var(--bt-r-control,14px); background:var(--bt-accent-bg,#EAFBF4); color:var(--bt-accent-text,#087454); font:600 14px/1.5 "Nunito Sans",sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-nav:active { opacity:.85; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Passive count
components.description: Information, not selection or an action. No fake interaction.
components.css: .ds-count { display:inline-flex; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--bt-subtle,#F6F3EC); color:var(--bt-text-2,#7C746E); font:600 12px/1.5 "Nunito Sans",sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: The signature is how the product represents effort, academic context and earned outcomes—not a green card template. Time becomes accumulated material; courses retain identity; exams interrupt ordinary planning; progress has a destination; rewards are objects; academic relationships explain relevance. Utility UI stays quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Exam priority that survives a small screen and loss of color.
Shared reward objects, not independent celebration banners.
Familiar, neutral controls around these six signatures.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every strong color must answer “what does this mean?” No answer means neutral UI. No new palette is introduced by this document. Separate exam/error semantic aliases can be established during a shared exam implementation; do not invent per-page shades now.

rules.name: The Diagonal Rule
rules.body: A thin bottom-left → top-right stroke means a date is strictly past, not completed, failed or an exam. It stays behind content, subordinate to exam identity; never strikes through the exam's label. Today's/future cells have no past stroke. Multi-course tint splitting is legacy behavior to retire, not a second meaning to standardize. No decorative diagonal elsewhere.
